sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Accent color
Replaces ReadEra's yellow with the wallpaper color on Android 12 and later, or green below 12. Another color can be picked in the patches menu.
App theme
Adds a black AMOLED theme for the library, menus and Settings, picked in the patches menu. Book pages keep their own colors.
Background listening
Keeps Read aloud playing after switching apps or turning the screen off.
Colored quotes
Saves selected text as a quote in one of five colors, picked from the text selection menu.
Copy with source
Copies selected text with the book title and author. Found under More in the text selection menu.
Custom fonts
Adds reading fonts from a folder on the device. The folder is picked on ReadEra's Fonts screen.
Dictionary section
Adds a side menu page with the words saved from every book.
Dictionary word colors
Saves a selected word to Dictionary in one of five colors.
Full book descriptions
Shows the whole book description in About document, including very short and very long ones.
Library full screen
Hides the status bar and navigation bar in the library, as full-screen mode does in the reader. Turned on in the patches menu.
Library view modes
Adds Full, Brief, Thumbnails and Grid layouts for book lists to the library menu.
Lock screen on Read chapter aloud
Locks the phone when Read chapter aloud starts, and the chapter keeps playing. Turned on in the patches menu. Needs device admin access.
Material 3 controls
Gives switches, checkboxes and radio buttons in Settings and dialogs the Material 3 look.
More sleep timer choices
Adds 5 and 10 minute options to the Read aloud sleep timer.
Omit words and symbols
Makes Read aloud skip the words and symbols on a list, without changing the book. The list is edited in the patches menu.
Page counter in long chapters
Keeps the page counter next to the chapter title in chapters of 1,000 pages or more.
Page thumbnails
Adds a button next to the page slider that shows the book's pages as thumbnails.
Quotes and notes section
Adds a side menu page with the quotes, bookmarks and reviews from every book. Tapping one opens the book at that spot.
Read aloud from selection
Starts Read aloud from the selected text. Found under More in the text selection menu.
Read aloud notification controls
Adds Stop, Previous and Next buttons to the Read aloud notification. On Android 7 to 10 it also counts down the sleep timer.
Read chapter aloud
Reads one chapter aloud and stops at its end. Long-press the chapter in Contents to start.
Read footnotes aloud
Reads each footnote aloud where the book refers to it, in place of its number. Works in EPUB, FB2 and MOBI books.
Remove nags
Removes the rate-the-app and promotion pop-ups and the Go to Premium button.
Search selection in book
Searches the book for the selected text and lists every match. Found under More in the text selection menu.
Skip headers and footers
Makes Read aloud skip page headers, footers and page numbers in PDF and DjVu files.
Speech pitch slider
Adds a voice pitch slider from 0.5x to 2x to Settings > Text to speech (TTS).
Speech rate slider
Sets Read aloud speed from 0.1x to 4x with a slider on the Speech rate screen.
